Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.service

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.service.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Account registration, login and password changes (US-01, US-02, US-06).

Passwords are never stored: only a BCrypt hash, which includes its own random salt. Login gives the same "Invalid username or password" message whichever part is wrong, so the app does not reveal which usernames exist.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public User register(String username, String email, String password)
      Creates a new account. The username is also used as the starting display name.
      Parameters:
      username - a unique, non-blank username
      email - a valid email address
      password - at least 8 characters; stored only as a BCrypt hash
      Returns:
      the newly created user
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the email is invalid, the username is blank or already taken, or the password is too short

    • login

      public User login(String username, String password)
      Checks a username and password against the stored hash.
      Parameters:
      username - the account's username
      password - the password as typed
      Returns:
      the signed-in user
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - with the same message whether the username or the password is wrong

    • changePassword

      public void changePassword(String username, String currentPassword, String newPassword)
      Changes a signed-in user's password after confirming their current one.
      Parameters:
      username - the signed-in user's username
      currentPassword - their existing password, as a check that it is really them
      newPassword - the new password, at least 8 characters
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the current password is wrong or the new one is too short

    • validatePassword

      private void validatePassword(String password)
      The one place the password rule lives, shared by registration and password changes.
      Parameters:
      password - the password to check
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is missing or shorter than 8 characters
